title.narrative: Exchange rate impacts relevant to Danish Development Cooperation

description.narrative: Exchange rate impact relevant to Danish Development Cooperation resulting from conversion to and from foreign currency in relation to transfers between accounts, receivables, and liabilities as well as regarding balances of cash in foreign bank accounts. The annual total exchange rate impact can result in a net cost or a net benefit for the administrative expenses relevant to Danish Development Cooperation.

participating-org.narrative: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark, Danida

tag.narrative: Ensure significant mobilization of resources from a variety of sources, including through enhanced development cooperation, in order to provide adequate and predictable means for developing countries, in particular least developed countries, to implement programmes and policies to end poverty in all its dimensions
